senses.gloss: प्रयत a. (f. ता) 1. Self-subdued, keeping the organs of sense under restraint, R.i.95; 2. pure; 3. submissive.
प्रयत a. (f. ता) 1. Self-subdued, keeping the organs of sense under restraint, R.i.95; 2. pure; 3. submissive.
प्रयात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Advanced; 2. deceased, dead.
प्रयात (II) m. 1. An invasion; 2. a precipice.
प्रयात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Advanced; 2. deceased, dead.
प्रयत्न m. 1. Effort, exertion, endeavour; 2. care, caution; 3. labour, difficulty; 4. effort of the mouth in the production of articulate sounds (in gram.).
प्रयत्न-प्रेक्षणीय a. hardly visible.
प्रयस्त a. (f. स्ता) Dressed with condiments.
प्रयस्त a. (f. स्ता) Dressed with condiments.
प्रयाग (I) m. 1. A sacrifice; 2. an epithet of Indra; 3. a horse.
प्रयाग (II) m.n. A place of pilgrimage on the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā near Allahabad, M.ii.21.
प्रयाग-भय m. an epithet of Indra.
प्रयाचन n. Begging, imploring.
प्रयाज m. A principal sacrifice.

प्रयाण n. 1. Going forth, journey, मार्गं तावच्छृणु कथयतस्त्वत्प्रयाणानुरूपम् Megh.i.13; 2. the march of an enemy, an attack, an expedition, अस्य प्रयाणेषु समग्रशक्तेः R.vi.33, K.S.iii.43; 3. beginning, commencement; 4. death, departure, प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः Bg.vii.30; 5. the back of a horse; 6. the hind part of any animal.
प्रायण n. 1. Commencement, beginning; 2. the course of life; 3. death, voluntary death, M.ix.323.
प्रयाण-भंग m. a break in a journey, a halt.
प्रयाणक n. A journey, a march.
प्रयापित a. (f. ता) 1. Cused to go forward; 2. made to go away.
प्रयापित a. (f. ता) 1. Cused to go forward; 2. made to go away.
प्रयाम m. The same as नावाकी q.v.
प्रयास m. 1. Effort, exertion, endeavour, R.xii.53, xiv.51; 2. labour, difficulty.

प्रयुक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Harnessed, yoked; 2. appointed, nominated; 3. used, employed (as a word); 4. consequent on, produced by; 5. lost in meditation, abstracted; 6. set on; 7. put to interest (as money), (pp. of युज् with प्र q.v.).

प्रयुक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Harnessed, yoked; 2. appointed, nominated; 3. used, employed (as a word); 4. consequent on, produced by; 5. lost in meditation, abstracted; 6. set on; 7. put to interest (as money), (pp. of युज् with प्र q.v.).
प्रयुक्त-संस्कार a. refined, polished, R.iii.18.
प्रयुक्ति f. 1. Use, employment; 2. main object, occasion; 3. instigation.
प्रयुत n. A million.
प्रयुत्सु m. 1. A warrior; 2. air, wind; 3. a ram; 4. an ascetic; 5. an epithet of Indra.
प्रयुद्ध n. War, battle.
प्रयोक्तृ a. (f. क्त्री) 1. One who uses or employs (as a word); 2. one who instigates; 3. one who lends money on interest; 4. one who represents (a drama); 5. one who shoots (an arrow).
प्रयोक्तृ a. (f. क्त्री) 1. One who uses or employs (as a word); 2. one who instigates; 3. one who lends money on interest; 4. one who represents (a drama); 5. one who shoots (an arrow).

प्रयोग m. 1. Employment, use (as in शब्दप्रयोग); 2. usage, practice (as in भूरिप्रयोग); 3. hurling, throwing, sending, प्रयोगसंहारविभक्तमंत्रम् R.v.57; 4. application of magic or charms; 5. lending money on usury; 6. recitation, delivery; 7. exhibition of a dance, dancing, नृत्यप्रयोगविशदौ चरणौ क्षिपंती Mrich.i.; 8. representation of a drama; 9. experiment, practice, performance, (op. to शास्त्र ‘theory’), तदत्रभवानिमं मां च शास्त्रे Mal.i.; 10. beginning, commencement; 11. a plan, a contrivance; 12. consequence, result; 13. a horse.

प्रयोग-अतिशय m. bringing a character on the stage unexpectedly at the moment when his name is incidentally pronounced, यदि प्रयोग एकस्मिन् प्रयोगोऽन्यः प्रयुज्यते । तेन पात्रप्रवेशश्चेत् प्रयोगातिशयस्तदा).
प्रयोग-निपुण a. skilled in practice.
प्रयोजक m. 1. A founder, an institutor; 2. an author; 3. a legislator; 4. a money-lender.

प्रयोजन n. 1. Use, need, necessity, (with an inst., e.g. प्रतारणासमर्थस्य विद्यया किं प्रयोजनम्); 2. cause, motive; 3. purpose, aim, object, e.g. प्रयोजनमनुद्दिश्य न मंदोपि प्रवर्तते, or गुणवत्तापि परप्रयोजना R.viii.31; 4. profit, interest; 5. means of attaining, M.viii.100.
प्रयोज्य (I) a. (f. ज्या) 1. To be practised; 2. to be produced; 3. to be appointed; 4. to be thrown (as an अस्त्र).
प्रयोज्य (II) m. A servant.
प्रयोज्य (III) n. Capital, principal.
प्रयोज्य (I) a. (f. ज्या) 1. To be practised; 2. to be produced; 3. to be appointed; 4. to be thrown (as an अस्त्र).

प्राय m. 1. Departure of life, seeking death by fasting, प्रायोपवेशनमतिर्नृपतिर्बभूव R.viii.94, प्रायोपवेशसदृशं व्रतमस्थितस्य Ve.iii.; 2. fasting, abstaining from food; 3. the largest portion, majority, majority of cases, abundance, e.g. जलप्राय ‘abounding with water’; (in this sense, the word is often used at the end of adjectival compounds and is translatable by ‘in a majority of cases,’ ‘as a rule,’ ‘generally,’ ‘for the most part,’ ‘almost,’ e.g. जांगलं सस्यसंपन्नमार्यप्रायमनाविलम् M.iii.69); 4. a condition of life; 5. a termination denoting similarity with a degree of inferiority, e.g. मृतप्राय ‘all but dead,’ नष्टप्राय &c.(प्रायेण is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) in all probability, most likely; (2) mostly, as a rule, प्रायेण सामग्र्यविधौ गुणानां पराङ्मुखी विश्वसृजः प्रवृत्तिः K.S.iii.28, Megh.ii.24, Kir.v.49.)
प्राय-उपगमन न्।, -उपवेश म्।, -उपवेशन न्।, -उपवेशनिका ऋ। n. abstaining from food and awaiting the approach of death.
प्राय-उपवेश m. abstaining from food and awaiting the approach of death.
प्राय-उपगमन न्।, -उपवेश म्।, -उपवेशन न्।, -उपवेशनिका ऋ। n. abstaining from food and awaiting the approach of death.
प्राय-उपवेशनिका f. abstaining from food and awaiting the approach of death.
प्राय-उपेत a. prepared to die by abstaining from food.
प्राय-उपविष्ट a. one who abstains from food and awaits death.
प्राय-दर्शन n. an ordinary phenomenon.
प्रायश्चित्त n. expiatory act, atonement, indemnification, a religious act performed for the atonement of sinful conduct, मातुः पापस्य भरतः प्रायश्चित्तमिवाकरोत् R.xii.29, M.i.116.
प्रायश्चित्ति f. expiatory act, atonement, indemnification, a religious act performed for the atonement of sinful conduct, मातुः पापस्य भरतः प्रायश्चित्तमिवाकरोत् R.xii.29, M.i.116.
प्रायश्चित्तिन् a. one who has to make expiation.
प्राय-शस् ind. mostly, generally, in all probability, दिशतु तव हितानि प्रायशो वांछितानि Rt.ii.28.
प्रायणीय (I) a. (f. या) Introductory, initiatory.
प्रायणीय (II) n. The first day of a Soma sacrifice.
प्रायणीय (I) a. (f. या) Introductory, initiatory.

प्रायस् ind. 1. Mostly, for the most part, generally, as a rule, प्रायो मूर्खः परिभवविधौ नाभिमानं तनोति Sr.T.16, प्रायश्चापं न वहति भयान्मन्मथः षट्पदज्यम् Megh.ii.10; 2. most likely, in all probability, प्रायः पयोधरसमुन्नतिरत्र हेतुः Ud.
प्रायाणिक a. (f. की) Suitable for a journey, necessary for a journey.

प्रायुद्धेषिन् m. A horse.
